d: Carolyn leaves the big city with her daughter Jordi for her childhood village. She meets her former fiance and finds a lost boy who she wants to adopt, but Jordi is not too keen on the idea.

In a small town, high-school dean Alana and her vivacious teenage daughter Samantha plan a holiday concert to save the school with the help of the new maintenance man, Army veteran Johnny, and his quiet son Max.
A young woman who comes from a life of privilege falls for the owner of a soup kitchen after discovering a Dear Santa letter written by his seven year old daughter.
During a blizzard at christmas, a man becomes snowbound with ex-wife, her wealthy suitor, his former mother in law, and his daughter.
High-powered event planner Hayley expects a quiet mountain Christmas with family—until she learns Paul, her ex’s meddling friend, will be there too. As sparks fly, she begins falling for him instead.
Two feuding business associates fall for each other while escorting a celebrity dog on a Christmas promotional tour.
In order to gain access into Heaven, Sarah is sent back down to earth as an \"angel in training\" with 12 days to help a soul in need.
A woman visiting New York City at Christmas helps a grieving man rediscover the magic of the holidays.
Looking to escape his Royal life, a dashing prince comes to the United States to start a business in a small town in upstate New York and winds up falling for a former Olympic ice skater.

A young woman living a picture-perfect city life is asked by her parents, owners of Michigan's historic Holly Hotel, to come home for Christmas. Once there, she realizes she might be wrong about what a picture-perfect life truly looks like.
